harness: Issue 399 scrolling workload; same checked-out bytes for both source versions

pilot.interpretation: descriptive overhead only; n=1 is not inferential
pilot.targeting: Optional pilot_scenarios restricts diagnostic cells only; targeted pilot cannot qualify baseline/comparison. The unfiltered primary pilot has 12 children.

baseline.warmup: per fresh process and excluded from measured summaries

compare.pair_order: baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline alternating by pair
compare.pairing: same VM, harness, dependencies, protocol, seed, scenario, and cache
compare.statistics: independent processes; GUI events are never pooled as independent runs

statistics.bootstrap_interval: paired mean delta percentile bounds at 2.5 and 97.5 percent

reports.raw_events_truncated: integer count; must equal zero for a qualifying child report

policy_notes.scroll_metrics: Scroll-only metrics are required in addition to common instrumented metrics; each must have matching measured raw-event evidence. Missing observations block qualification; no zero values are synthesized.
policy_notes.matrix: Primary matrix: three loaded extents (100, 500, 2000), two cache states and two instrumentation modes; pilot 12, baseline 60, compare 120. Separate 5000 stress is nonblocking by explicit owner instruction.
policy_notes.repetitions: Ten independent processes per baseline cell and ten matched process pairs per comparison cell.
policy_notes.bootstrap: Two thousand deterministic paired resamples produce the 95 percent percentile interval.
policy_notes.timeouts: Each child is limited to 90 seconds and the full driver invocation to 2400 seconds.
policy_notes.lifecycle: A separate 100-photo sample performs one gallery switch and two reopens after primary timings; 64-photo paging, IDs and viewer-owned timer/worker teardown must validate.

renderer_request: PHP_GALLERY_CANVAS_GRID=1 for both sources; the optimized control ignores the experimental opt-in

measurement_phases.setup: Fresh mount and real catalogue admission: separate scalar durations and fixed callback/image timing count-total-max aggregates; no per-callback raw rows or startup heartbeat percentiles
measurement_phases.warmup: Warm cache trace priming and lifecycle verification excluded from primary operation counts and raw events
measurement_phases.measured: Already-admitted catalogue interactions: complete raw observations with unchanged 20000-event cap and strict zero-truncation admission
measurement_phases.operation_counts: Actual setup plus measured Tk/Pillow operations; no warm replay or lifecycle operations

fixture_bundle.scope: One exact-generator archive prepared per driver before independent children; no application/cache sharing
fixture_bundle.identity: Fixed ZIP epoch, seed, Pillow version, common-source SHA-256, member sizes/hashes and driver-supplied archive SHA-256; each child recomputes its loaded prefix dataset hash
fixture_bundle.accounting: Stage preparation seconds and per-child fixture_load_ms are separate; scenario_elapsed_ms starts after verified fixture loading and ends before lifecycle; driver child elapsed_seconds includes loading and teardown
fixture_bundle.progress: Bounded diagnostic-only progress sidecars at phase transitions and every eight page reads/input actions; never accepted instead of child success JSON

stress.scope: Separate stress observation only; any timeout is reported and does not block the primary P0 baseline or P1
stress.activation: Run separately after the first functional Canvas prototype using the existing protocol/workflow; never merge stress failures into a successful primary matrix
